description.zh:
实例ID。

必须传入实例ID，否则调用会失败。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看您的实例ID。
><notice>
如果公共实例没有ID，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。
></notice>
description.en:
Instance ID.  

You must specify an instance ID. Otherwise, the invocation will fail. You can view your instance ID on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.  
><notice>  
If your public instance does not have an ID, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).  
></notice>

description.zh: 推送任务ID，调用[PushSpeech](~~217573~~)成功后返回的**Data**字段为推送任务ID。
description.en: The Push Task ID. After you invoke [PushSpeech](~~217573~~) successfully, the **Data** field in the response contains the Push Task ID.
The current page number, starting from 1, with a maximum value of 10000.

description.zh: 指定每页返回数据的最大条数，取值范围：1~50，默认值为20。
description.en: Specifies the maximum number of entries returned per page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value is 20.

description.zh: 项目ID，是项目的唯一标识，您可以通过[项目管理控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/things-service/projects)获取项目ID。
description.en: The project ID, which is the UUID of the project. You can obtain the project ID from the [Management Console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/things-service/projects).

description.zh:
推送任务的模式，不传则查询所有模式。

- **SINGLE_DEVICE**：单设备推送。
- **ALL**：全量设备推送。
- **GROUP_DEVICE**：分组设备推送。
description.en:
The pattern of the push task. If this parameter is not specified, tasks in all patterns are queried.

- **SINGLE_DEVICE**: push to a single device.
- **ALL**: push to all devices.
- **GROUP_DEVICE**: push to a group of devices.

description.zh:
查询语料推送任务的状态列表，不传则查询所有状态。

- **RUNNING**：运行中。
- **CANCEL**：取消。
- **SUCCESS**：成功。
- **TIMEOUT**：超时。
description.en:
The list of statuses of corpus push tasks to query. If this parameter is not specified, tasks in all statuses are queried.

- **RUNNING**: running.
- **CANCEL**: canceled.
- **SUCCESS**: succeeded.
- **TIMEOUT**: timed out.

title.zh: 查询语料推送任务列表
title.en: Query the list of speech corpus push tasks

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot query-speech-push-job --iot-instance-id iot-06000000 --project-code 0Ykj000000000000000000000000Av0I --push-mode ALL --job-code tBUm00000000000000000000000QPGT --page-size 20 --page-id 1 --status-list example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot QuerySpeechPushJob --region cn-hangzhou --PageId 1 --StatusList.1 'example-string' --IotInstanceId 'iot-06000000' --PageSize 20 --JobCode tBUm00000000000000000000000QPGT --ProjectCode 0Ykj000000000000000000000000Av0I --PushMode ALL
